verdict.rationale: SigNoz's own docs claim it collects metrics from infrastructure and logs from cloud services, so the product addresses the axis directly but only in general terms. The pack never names a SigNoz-maintained agent or collector, a Kubernetes or container integration, or specific cloud-service integrations. A hands-on user also reported the docs only covered application-stack integration and had no guidance for host-level CPU/memory/disk metrics. That is a documentation gap rather than a proven capability failure, so it lowers quality and confidence instead of making the verdict disputed. Missing for 10: documented vendor-maintained agent, explicit host metrics integration, container and Kubernetes instrumentation, named cloud-service integrations, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument hosts, containers, Kubernetes, and cloud services through vendor-maintained agents and integrations

citations.quote: Collect metrics from applications, infrastructure, and existing Prometheus setups.
Collect logs from files, stdout, FluentBit/FluentD/Logstash, OpenTelemetry SDKs, HTTP endpoints, and cloud services.
